credits.title: I Built a Rocket Imagining Your Arrival
credits.overview: Fifty-something Rosa, lying in an MRI scanner, is prompted to summon a happy memory. She plunges into a meandering, subconscious road trip with her indomitable mother, both queer, where wild imagination becomes a tender, unruly form of therapy.

credits.title: Derail
credits.overview: Renata exists through the gaze of others. Her routine is permeated by guilt, which invades the surreal landscape of her thoughts and reveals a strange obsession.

credits.title: London
credits.overview: London, a disabled young adult working in a fetish house, finds himself caught in an unexpected dilemma when offered the chance to understand his body through a medical exam.

credits.title: Olho Vivo
credits.overview: A short film that portrays four people from Ceará who migrated to Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo and reflect on their attempts and changes. When fear ceased to be just fear and became the courage to be vulnerable.

credits.title: Acsexybility
credits.overview: Located at the intersection of disability and queerness, this documentary enriches, implicates, and breaks open the conversation around sexual life in the disabled community. credits.title: Partindo do princípio de que a Terra é plana, sou toda curva e desvio.
Fortaleza Hotel
credits.overview: Pilar, a young hotel maid, has her path crossed by Shin, a middle-aged South Korean guest. The plans of both go wrong and, despite everything that separates them, they end up getting closer and establishing a relationship of solidarity.

credits.title: Bittersweet Power
credits.overview: In one night, Lucas, Luiza and Bia remember the pains and delights of being who they are.
